name: omnisense/omnishow
description: Omnishow: what is shown, under any PHP host, whoever keeps it - in three families of contracts: work (the record of a film, a series or an episode: titles, dates, cast and crew, pictures, identifiers across registers, a season's episodes, where to watch, its trailers), video (a video hosted elsewhere: its record, its player and the player's privacy-friendly variant, a channel's videos, playlists, a search) and live (whether a channel is on air, its stream, its schedule). Providers are packages of their own (omnishow/tmdb, omnishow/omdb, omnishow/tvdb, omnishow/trakt, omnishow/wikidata, omnishow/youtube, omnishow/vimeo, omnishow/twitch); the Symfony and Laravel bridges live in omnibridge.

suggest.omnishow/tmdb: The Movie Database: search, records with cast and pictures, episodes, where to watch (JustWatch's data)
suggest.omnishow/omdb: OMDb: records by IMDb number with IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic ratings
suggest.omnishow/tvdb: TheTVDB: series and their episodes, films
suggest.omnishow/trakt: Trakt: records and episodes, identifiers across registers
suggest.omnishow/wikidata: Wikidata: open records (CC0) and identifiers across registers, no key
suggest.omnishow/youtube: YouTube: videos, channels, playlists, a search; what a channel broadcasts live and has scheduled (an API key)
suggest.omnishow/vimeo: Vimeo: videos, a user's videos, showcases, a search (an access token, or a client id and secret)
suggest.omnishow/twitch: Twitch: whether a channel is live, its stream and its schedule (a client id and secret)
suggest.omnisense/omnibridge: The host contracts; omnibridge/symfony and omnibridge/laravel wire omnishow into their host when a site needs it
